title: Lab 30 — NetworkPolicy
description: By default every Pod can communicate with every other Pod. NetworkPolicies restrict that traffic by allow-listing specific sources and destinations...

steps.title: Step 1: Set exam aliases and create workloads
Step 2: Default deny: block all ingress
Step 3: Selective allow: only role=allowed can reach the backend
Step 4: Egress lockdown: allow DNS only
